fields.postcondition: the silo registers the named persistence options, option logging formatter, and the matching ArgentSeaGrainStorageFactory delegate under providerName
fields.response: configure the named OrleansDbPersistenceOptions or OrleansShardPersistenceOptions on services, register ConfigureNamedOptionForLogging for that options type and providerName, and call builder.AddGrainStorage(providerName, ArgentSeaGrainStorageFactory.CreateDb) or builder.AddGrainStorage(providerName, ArgentSeaGrainStorageFactory.CreateShards), defaulting providerName to ProviderConstants.DEFAULT_STORAGE_PROVIDER_NAME ('Default') on default-name overloads
fields.subject: ArgentSeaSiloBuilderExtensions
fields.trigger: AddArgentSeaDbOrleansGrainStorage or AddArgentSeaShardOrleansGrainStorage is invoked on an ISiloBuilder
